cases.name: git stash list passes, bare git stash is denied
the word git inside a quoted string is not a git command
git.mutations ask in kit.config.json turns the git commit denial into ask
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/ga-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R $R-wt && mkdir -p $R && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'x\n' > f && git add -A && git commit -qm init && mkdir -p .claude && printf '{\"git\": {\"mutations\": \"ask\"}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && cd {{ROOT}} && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m x"}}' | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R bash {{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput | .permissionDecision + "|" + .permissionDecisionReason'

expect.stdout: ask|git commit modifies the repository: this repo sets git.mutations to ask

cases.name: a worktree without its own kit.config.json reads git.mutations from the main checkout
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/gw-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R $R-wt && mkdir -p $R && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'x\n' > f && git add -A && git commit -qm init && mkdir -p .claude && printf '{\"git\": {\"mutations\": \"ask\"}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && git worktree add -q $R-wt && cd {{ROOT}} && printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m x"}}' | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R-wt bash {{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput | .permissionDecision + "|" + .permissionDecisionReason'; git -C $R worktree remove --force $R-wt
